ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try streaming on my TV; the remote's TV controls appeal to me, even though I wouldn't use 4K on my current set.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I regularly buy memory cards for my devices, and this is a familiar capacity with a useful adapter.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm more interested in practical camera and device accessories right now, and I don't need earbuds.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd pick this up for connecting my TV equipment; the longer cable would give me placement flexibility.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming interests me, but I'd choose the other Fire TV Stick on this page instead of buying both.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 3.5 Inch to x2 SSD / 2.5 Inch Internal Hard Drive Mounting Kit [SATA and Power Cables Included] (BK-HDCC); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm not working on a desktop storage upgrade, so I wouldn't have a use for this kit.
ItemID: NA; Title: TP-Link 5 Port Gigabit Ethernet Network Switch | Plug and Play | Desktop or Wall-Mount | Plastic Case Ethernet Splitter | Fanless | Traffic Optimization | Unmanaged (TL-SG1005D); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don't currently need more wired network connections.
ItemID: NA; Title: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extender EX2700 - Coverage Up to 800 Sq Ft and 10 devices with N300 Wireless Signal Booster & Repeater (Up to 300Mbps Speed), and Compact Wall Plug Design; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I wouldn't buy an extender without a Wi-Fi coverage problem to solve.
ItemID: NA; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A portable speaker isn't something I'm looking for during this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Motorola SURFboard SB6121 Cable Modem (SB6121); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no immediate modem replacement need, and I'd need to check compatibility with my internet service.
